description: Analyze a public LinkedIn profile or company page without a Flux account: pulls the latest ~50 posts (once per profile) and returns a teaser: post count, average engagement, the format that beats the baseline, the top post and the recent trend, plus a preview_id. The full breakdown (best day and hour, top and bottom posts with reasons, trends by format) and keyword search need a free Flux account: call preview_posting_insights or preview_search_posts with the preview_id, which asks the person to sign in where the client supports it, or give the person the continue_url if that call fails. Call claim_preview after sign-in only when the person says the profile is theirs.

linkedin_url.description: Public LinkedIn profile or company URL, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/janedoe

name: preview_profile
title: Preview a LinkedIn profile
